@traySearch.description: Tray menu: shows the search panel.

@trayTerminal.description: Tray menu: shows or hides the floating terminal.

@traySettings.description: Tray menu: opens Settings (not built yet, shown disabled).

@trayCheckUpdates.description: Tray menu: checks for updates (not built yet, shown disabled).

@trayEditPresets.description: Tray menu, until Settings exist: opens presets.json in the default editor. Not in copy.md yet.

@searchTagApp.description: Tag at the right of an app's result row.

@searchTagPreset.description: Tag at the right of a preset's result row.

@presetSubtitle.description: Subtitle of a preset's result row.

@presetSubtitleShell.description: Subtitle of a preset without a command (a plain terminal).

@searchHintClear.description: Footer hint while the field has text.

@searchHintClose.description: Footer hint while the field is empty.

searchNoResultsHint: Try another name for the app, like its English name or pinyin.
searchNoPresetsHint: Want to run a command in a folder? Add a preset in Settings.

@searchNoPresetsHint.description: Added under no results when there is no preset at all.

@searchFinding.description: While the apps are listed for the first time. Not in copy.md yet.

searchOpenFailed: Couldn’t open “{name}”. It may have been moved or deleted.

@searchOpenFailed.description: When an app fails to open.

@termTabDefault.description: Tab title of a preset without a name.

@termFinished.description: Bar under the terminal when its command ended with exit code 0.

@termFinishedCode.description: Bar under the terminal when its command ended with another exit code.

@termRunAgain.description: Button of the finished bar (Enter presses it).

@termCloseTab.description: Secondary button of the finished bar.

termCommandMissing: Can’t find the command “{command}”. Check the command in this preset.

@termCommandMissing.description: When the preset's command is not found (exit code 127).

termFolderMissing: Can’t find the folder {folder}. Opened in your home folder instead.

@termFolderMissing.description: Notice above the terminal when the preset's folder is missing.
